findings.claim: Native API verification is not reproducible because rustdoc is generated with the moving +stable toolchain.
findings.evidence: The generator invokes cargo +stable doc, while the workflow installs only an exact Flutter version and no exact Rust toolchain; any stable Rust update can change the 798 hashed rustdoc artifacts and make docs:native-api:verify fail without a source change, contradicting the acceptance criterion requiring deterministic verification.
findings.suggested_fix: Pin an exact Rust toolchain from the release authority, install that version in the workflow, and invoke Cargo with the exact pin when generating and verifying rustdoc.

findings.claim: Pull requests that change only documentation visual snapshots do not trigger the documentation workflow.
findings.evidence: The path filter is tests/browser/v3-docs-pages*; GitHub path-filter * does not cross /, so files under tests/browser/v3-docs-pages.spec.ts-snapshots/ are excluded even though the diff adds the desktop and mobile baselines there.
